description: Several small, brightly colored saucer plates are stacked on a green cloth surface, with a blank wall and a curved white backdrop nearby. The right hand reaches in and slides the top red plate off the stack to the right and sets it down, then lifts the green plate to reveal a blue plate beneath and places the green plate above and slightly right; next the hand slides the blue plate away to the lower right, leaving the yellow plate separated to the left as the stack is fully unstacked.
